_note: PUT this to /v2/acts/{actorId} as a pricingInfos array entry. PAY_PER_EVENT only on BRONZE. startedAt must be 14+ days out. Apify auto-adds 20% margin. Greenhouse + Lever public APIs are keyless (no browser, no proxy), so compute per company is tiny. Premium account-intelligence pricing. Companies not found on any ATS are returned but never charged. First 5 hot_account per run are free for validation.

quiet_account.eventDescription: A company found on Greenhouse or Lever with no open roles right now. Confirms the ATS and that the account is not currently hiring.

active_account.eventDescription: A company with open roles: open-role count, departments hiring, locations, senior-role count, newest posting, and sample titles. A live hiring signal on the account.

hot_account.eventDescription: A company scaling fast: at or above the hot threshold of open roles, with the full department and location breakdown. A strong buying trigger. The first 5 hot_account per run are free so you can validate output.
